name: cattracks
description: Records your open tabs so you can scrub back in time and restore any moment.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'none'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' https://cattracks.app; frame-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'
